sources.fullCitation: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester. “Nimm diesen Strauß Vergißmeinnicht.” Fox-trot; label credits “(Kaper – Rotter)” and “(Verlag: Roehr A.-G., Berlin)”. Grammophon, elektrische Aufnahme, Serie Polyfar “R” Orchester, Katalog-Nr. B 50959, Bestell-Nr. 22222, side marked 2, n.d. The uploader gives Berlin, 1929 as the recording and first release. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
